mutants.note: m && d instead of m || d: a day overflow always changes the month too, and a month overflow always changes the year (caught by the first clause), so no input has month-or-day differ without both or the year differing.

Default as-of day from Date.now()/86400001 differs from /86400000 only in the first ~21 seconds after midnight UTC (20,782 days x 1 ms); every test and every user who sets an as-of date is unaffected, and a test for it would depend on the clock.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
